Highlight Clip: Vitalik: Traditional On-Chain Applications May No Longer Exist in Two Years Vitalik: Traditional On-Chain Applications May No Longer Exist in Two Years On October 6, 2026, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said at the OKX NOW event in Singapore that over the next two years, Ethereum transaction costs are expected to fall further, privacy capabilities will improve, and the integration of AI with on-chain applications will accelerate. He said future on-chain interactions may increasingly be handled by bots, while traditional applications could become less prominent, with AI directly interpreting on-chain offers and filtering transactions on users’ behalf. — link

Abstract to Shut Down on Dec. 15; Igloo Says It Lost Tens of Millions Over Two Years Abstract will shut down on December 15, 2026, citing high operating costs, limited liquidity, a restricted DeFi ecosystem and weaker market demand. Parent company Igloo said it lost tens of millions of dollars over the past two years keeping Abstract operating while searching for product-market fit and profitability. In July 2024, Igloo raised over $11 million in a Founders Fund-led round to establish Cube Labs and support Abstract’s development. Igloo will now refocus resources on Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU. — link

MAS says Hyperliquid not regulated; firm insists it is based in Singapore: FT According to the FT, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) said it is not aware of Hyperliquid being regulated in any major jurisdiction and has previously warned investors that its perpetual futures are not regulated by MAS. People familiar with the regulator’s thinking said MAS does not consider Hyperliquid to be based in Singapore due to its “decentralised nature” and therefore believes it should fall outside its jurisdiction. However, Hyperliquid Labs confirmed to the FT that it is based in Singapore, while corporate documents reviewed by the FT list Singapore as its registered headquarters. Hyperliquid said it “is not, and has never claimed to be, licensed or authorised by MAS” and remains committed to engaging constructively with regulators. — link

Highlight Clip: Michael Saylor: AI Outperforms What My Entire Team Could Do in a Month Michael Saylor: AI Outperforms What My Entire Team Could Do in a Month Strategy founder Michael Saylor said in an October 2 interview with the Bitcoin Policy Institute that AI crossed a major inflection point earlier this year. He said that when using the most advanced models, even if he put lawyers, financiers, marketing professionals, executives, and himself in a room for a month, they still would not produce work as good as the AI. Saylor believes AI agents are increasingly taking over tasks once performed by humans, with billions of agents eventually operating around the clock. — link
